purpose: Determine whether independent published marked-individual movement/recapture/translocation records can support future external EOG minimum-constraint-relaxation tests without post-outcome source or target selection.

source_references.publication: Moura et al. (2021) Movement, translocation and MRR data for Heliconius butterflies
source_references.declared_research_unit: individual mark-release-recapture, experimental translocation and site fidelity; not population colonization
mandatory_evidence_for_geo_only_followup: explicit captured or released source location
explicit later observed destination or recapture location
metric geographic distance or independently recoverable spatial coordinates
mandatory_evidence_for_full_MRR: same observational clock and source hypotheses
source_references.source_only_read_permissions: file metadata (publisher file digest, byte size, version), CSV header, total number of rows and README first heading only; NO individual observations or outcome values read

source_references.publication: Jreidini and Green (2022) Artificial displacement alters movement behavior of a terrestrial amphibian
source_references.declared_research_unit: translocated marked toads from original site to release and recapture, not natural origin-to-colonization migration
source_references.source_only_read_permissions: file metadata, CSV header, row count, RTF header preview only, no event-level values

source_endpoints.published_version_policy: Most recent published version whose year agrees with frozen publication year; if versions ambiguous, STOP_VERSION_AMBIGUOUS instead of choosing based on rows
source_endpoints.allow_trusted_public_cloud_storage_redir: S3/CloudFront only when redirect originates from official Dryad public API URL; record final host, never output signed URL or secret query

schema_only_gates: official DOI and version identity from REST API; source title check, no generic search fallback
exact expected filename multiset from publisher landing page, verified against file metadata and actual version ZIP contents
SHA256 for metadata JSON, downloaded ZIP, and each expected file; verify publisher digest where published
CSV header names and total row counts only; no row-level release/recapture or response values computed
three-axis MRR cannot proceed if geographic/environment/barrier source covariates are absent; geographic-only may proceed separately only under new pre-score protocol
translocation site is an experimentally assigned release, not natural founder
the Dryad file archive is not committed, shared or uploaded to Github artifacts; only aggregate metadata receipt
NO predictive EOG-WF endpoint (3 scored /31 scientific STOP/3 admin excluded); no historical Glanville overwrite
